name: Chas Chandler
hook: Quit his own band to manage and produce an unknown American guitarist he'd just seen play a Greenwich Village club.
blurb: Chandler was the bassist in the Animals until 1966, when he saw Jimi Hendrix playing in a small New York club, quit the band, and brought Hendrix to London as his manager and producer. He produced Hendrix's first single, 'Hey Joe' (1966), and the album 'Are You Experienced' (1967) before their working relationship ended in 1968. He is a clear case of one person carrying an artist between two scenes on his own: from the American club circuit to the London scene that made Hendrix a star.

signatureTracks.title: Hey Joe (produced for Jimi Hendrix)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: Hendrix's debut UK single, produced by Chandler within months of discovering him.

signatureTracks.title: Purple Haze (produced for Jimi Hendrix)
signatureTracks.whyThisOne: The breakthrough single that made Hendrix a star in Britain, a year after Chandler brought him over.
